idea: Run Monte Carlo Tree Search over bottom-left skyline placements. Each move picks the side of the next square at the lowest-leftmost skyline corner from a small set of rational sizes, and rollouts finish greedily, with the remaining squares counted at their best feasible equal size. Use UCT statistics shared through a transposition table keyed on the skyline profile.
